component: OpenPGP display sink and MIME handoff

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The mixed parser checks top-level/single-child/signature eligibility, display context and a parseable message date before invoking the sink. The sink requires t=p and signature data b before awaiting detached verification and updating security status. The added test assertions check signed and encrypted icon states separately; they do not validate malformed-header, date or asynchronous-error paths. Native Promise completion/rejection handling is not established by this handoff.
title: Unobtrusive signature UI verification has explicit message and sink eligibility gates
